title: Robust Sales at Sotheby’s, Phillips Suggest Art Market Upswing

title: A Blade of Grass Names 2026 “In Fellowship” Cohort
summary: New York-based arts nonprofit A Blade of Grass (ABoG) has revealed the three members of the 2026 In Fellowship cohort. title: New List Names Eleven Most Endangered Historical Sites in US
summary: On Wednesday, the National Trust for Historic Preservation released its annual list of the most endangered historic sites in the United States. summary: The Sainsbury Centre, a highly popular art museum in Norwich England, announced this week that it had received a donation of £91.2 million from the politician and philanthropist Lord David Sainsbury. title: 98,000 People Rush to Defense of Arts Trustee Misan Harriman in Wake of Antisemitism Accusations
